$comment: Curated Claude Code permission baseline adapted from the idd-skill v0.11.0 opt-in template (see docs/permissions.md#claude-code-permission-baseline for the rationale, scope, and known flag/path matching gotchas). This repository has explicitly recorded `mergePolicy: fully_autonomous_merge` in .github/idd/config.json, so `Bash(gh pr merge*)` is allowed below and the template's `node scripts/idd-merge-execute.mjs` / `node bin/idd-merge-execute.mjs` deny entries are intentionally omitted -- worker and merge-capable credentials are the same trusted session under that policy. This allow only changes whether Claude Code prompts before `gh pr merge`; it does not by itself satisfy the workflow's own F2/F3 merge gates. `gh api` is deliberately NOT allowlisted here (see the gh-api DELETE-verb trap in the doc); the DELETE-verb deny entries below remain as defense in depth. Personal additions belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which layers on top of this file.
